summary: A pilot quantifier module in the Chatzikyriakidis-Luo MTT style (CNs as types, via AdjectivesExtension.v with CN := Set): unary quantifiers no/exactly_n/at_least_n/at_most_n over CN-as-type restrictors with NoDup lists as the cardinality surrogate; proportional quantifiers (most, few, many, more_than_half) defined against an unconstrained Parameter domain_size; ad hoc non-standard quantifiers (only := all, except with a hard-coded 3-exception bound, almost_all, infinitely/finitely_many, between, roughly with a Parameter tolerance); Barwise & Cooper properties (conservativity, up/downward monotonicity) with monotonicity of some/all/no proved; scope ambiguity of 'every student read some book' as two readings with the wide-scope entailment proved, a concrete bool countermodel proved, and a coincidence lemma proved. Two Admitted findings: only_not_conservative is FALSE as written (only := all is definitionally conservative — the file proves the negation as only_conservative), and scope_ambiguity is unprovable over the bare Student/Book/read parameters (NEEDS_ASSUMPTION; the concrete-domain version is proved).

sources.citation: Barwise, J. & Cooper, R. (1981). Generalized quantifiers and natural language. Linguistics and Philosophy 4:159-219.
Chatzikyriakidis, S. & Luo, Z. (2020). Formal Semantics in Modern Type Theories. Wiley/ISTE.
Chatzikyriakidis, S. & Luo, Z. (2013). Adjectives in a modern type-theoretical setting. Formal Grammar 2013 (source of the imported AdjectivesExtension.v base).

definitions_mapped.coq: most / few / many / more_than_half via Parameter domain_size : forall A:CN, nat

definitions_mapped.coq: conservative Q := forall A P, Q A P <-> Q A (fun x => True /\ P x)

definitions_mapped.note: with the restrictor a type, intersecting with A trivializes to True /\ P — the property holds for any extensional Q, so the substantive B&C universal cannot even be stated

evidence: Headline claim stated but not established: only_not_conservative (line 226) is Admitted and FALSE as written — only := all (line 79) is definitionally conservative and the file itself proves the negation (only_conservative, line 222), so B&C's signature non-conservativity fact is unprovable under the file's definitions.

Core definition changed: conservative (line 167) reduces B&C's Q(A)(B) <-> Q(A)(A cap B) to Q A P <-> Q A (True /\ P), which holds trivially for any extensional quantifier — the proved some_conservative/all_conservative verify a vacuous property.

Core definition changed: most/few/many (lines 52-67) compare exactly_n counts against Parameter domain_size, an uninterpreted nat with no axiom connecting it to the type's actual cardinality, so the proportional quantifiers do not denote the source's proportional determiners.
Second headline claim Admitted: scope_ambiguity (line 286) is unprovable over the bare parameters, as the file's own comment and scope_readings_coincide (line 275) demonstrate.
The proved content that is faithful: monotonicity of some/all/no (exact B&C properties) and the scope entailment plus a concrete bool countermodel for reading non-equivalence.
simplifications: NoDup lists as the cardinality surrogate for at_least_n/at_most_n/exactly_n
hard-coded thresholds: few = at most a quarter, many = at least half, except = at most 3 exceptions (sources treat these as context-dependent)
omissions: binary determiners Q(A)(B) with a set restrictor — the structure on which B&C conservativity, witness sets, and definability results live
permutation/isomorphism invariance, witness-set theorems, and every other named B&C result
any axiom making domain_size the cardinality of the domain
additions: exactly_n/at_least_n/at_most_n cardinality machinery and comparative quantifiers via lists
scope_readings_coincide and scope_readings_differ_bool (honest replacements for the unprovable abstract claims, apparently from a later repair pass)
12 signature Parameters for example sentences; one example (almost_all_alleged_innocent_or_guilty) ignores its bound variable and predicates of the constant john

determination_rationale: Evidenced by this pilot only: the unary CN-as-type quantifier signature (C&L's own) proves right-argument monotonicity but cannot state B&C conservativity non-trivially — with the restrictor a type, 'intersect with the restrictor' collapses to True — and CN := Set gives 'most' no access to a cardinality, forcing the unconstrained domain_size parameter. Recovering the headline GQ claims (the conservativity universal, non-conservativity of 'only', proportional determiners) requires re-founding the determiner type as binary over predicates/subsets of a domain with genuine finite cardinality. This is a determination floor from a weak formalization, not the theory's ceiling: B&C GQ theory itself is expected to fare better (likely slight_modification or as_is) under a proper binary encoding.

artifact_classes.description: CN := Set (imported base): common nouns identified with a universe, quantifiers quantify over all Sets; the type-as-restrictor move is what trivializes conservativity and erases the binary determiner structure
no finite sets or cardinality on types: NoDup lists surrogate for counting, and domain_size must be postulated as an uninterpreted Parameter because a Set has no cardinality operation

notes: Record produced by the batch audit sweep of 2026-09-05; the file predates the atlas zero-axiom discipline (12 signature Parameters here, and it imports AdjectivesExtension.v whose Tcn-interpretation Axioms are propositional but belong to that file's record). Header self-identifies as 'WorkingQuantifiers.v'. Count nuance: the theorem-regex count of 10 excludes the Admitted Example only_not_conservative, so proved(9) + admitted(2) spans 11 statements; both Admitted are classified findings (FALSE, NEEDS_ASSUMPTION), and the file's summary comment block overclaims ('only' listed as a delivered non-standard quantifier despite being defined as 'all').
